measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on analyzing user prompts for Text-to-Image (TTI) models to understand user intentions, preferences, and behaviors, particularly concerning explicit content, misogyny, harmful stereotypes (related to race, gender, appearance), and the uniformity of visual culture.
